decisions.reason: A reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry heritage, is shown on the home page, and represents heavy visible commitment, so the firm will persist with it.

The risk management software has been on its own page for two years and supports the announced move toward integration, automation and prediction, so any weak uptake would be read as a temporary adoption issue.
The CT phantom was launched only recently and builds on the established imaging QA offer, so it is too early to judge it a failure.

Although mammography is distant from the core business, the phantom was launched recently and publicly on its own page as part of the imaging expansion, so management will attribute slow sales to market entry effects.
The full field mammography phantom overlaps with Product D and is far from the core, which makes it a slight consolidation risk, but the fresh public commitment to imaging QA favors keeping it.
The imaging QA instrument line carries a substantial multi-model investment and is central to the firm's expansion into imaging, so the firm will strongly persist with it.
